top_signals.title: US warns of AI-powered attacks on Siemens PLCs in critical infrastructure
top_signals.summary: U.S. cybersecurity agencies warn that threat actors are using AI-generated scripts to exploit Siemens S7 Series programmable logic controllers (PLCs) in U.S. critical infrastructure. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
top_signals.summary: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
